sections.text_helper: Section 58.3 "LPTIM implementation" in chapter 58 (Low-power timer (LPTIM)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2929.
sections.section_content:
The table below describes LPTIM implementation on STM32N6x5/x7xx devices. The full set
of features is implemented in LPTIM1, LPTIM2 and LPTIM3. LPTIM4 and LPTIM5 support a
smaller set of features.
[Table 554. STM32N6x5/x7xx LPTIM features]
